sonnet.problem: The setup line says the divisions together have the whole year to cover. That rules out the wrong answers on card 2, 'Every division served all year long' and 'Each division served only in wartime', and points to the monthly rotation.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: Card 2 is a choice card about the twelve monthly divisions in 27:1-15. That stretch is a run of repeated detail (a commander, 24,000 men, a month), and the story card for 27:2-15 already summarizes it. It should not get a choice card.
sonnet.rule: A long stretch never gets a choice card.
